description: Reads one Sitecore background job by name or handle over the Authoring and Management API, returning its state, progress and messages. This is how you find out whether an index rebuild or other queued operation finished. Supply exactly one of jobName or handle.

handle.description: The job handle returned when the job was queued. Supply this or jobName.

jobName.description: The exact job name, e.g. 'Index_Update_IndexName=sitecore_master_index'. Supply this or handle.

name: authoring-get-job
